name: Homestead Ruins
description: What is left of the first settlement, where the portal first tore open. Weeds grow through the hearths, and something still stirs in the cellars.

name: Wanderer's Trail
description: The old road out of the ruins, worn smooth by voyagers who never came back the same way.

name: Wayfarer's Camp
description: A ring of tents and dying fires. Travelers trade stories here, and the night watch is never quiet.

name: Timber Grove
description: Ancient trees older than the timelines themselves. The paths shift when no one is looking.

name: Farmer's Fields
description: Golden fields that should be peaceful. The harvest has been strange since the portals began to open.

name: Traveler's Rest
description: An inn at the crossroads of every era. The innkeeper never seems to age.

name: Lost Artifact's Crypt
description: A sealed tomb where relics from forgotten timelines were buried, and where their guardians still wait.

name: The Carpenter's Guild
description: The workshop that built the first portal frames. Its halls echo with hammering, though the guild left long ago.

name: The Mechanist's Lab
description: Cerberon's first laboratory, full of half-finished machines that still hum when you walk past.

name: Abandoned Outpost
description: A watchtower at the edge of the known timelines. Its last report was never finished.

name: Hero's Haven
description: A frozen sanctuary where the greatest voyagers rest between lives. Not all of them rest peacefully.

name: Dahlia's Core
description: The heart of Project D.A.H.L.I.A. Few voyagers have seen it, and fewer still have understood it.
